title: Update mime-tree to depend on yencoding 0.3.0
description: mime-tree/Cargo.toml declares yencoding = { version = "0.2.0" } but calls DecodedPart::new and YencMetadata::new which only exist in the local (unreleased) yencoding. Update to version = "0.3.0" after yencoding 0.3.0 is published. Bump mime-tree version as needed.
